When you want to respond to the user or have the final answer, call the 'final_answer' tool with argument 'answer'.
When the task is complete or you cannot proceed, call the 'done' tool.
Do not repeat the same tool call with the same arguments. If a search/retrieval tool has already returned relevant results, call 'final_answer' with the answer instead of searching again. - Before calling final_answer, gather the information needed to actually answer. If a search/retrieval tool (such as KB_search) is available and you have not used it yet for this task, call it before answering. Do not end with only clarifying questions when you can retrieve the answer yourself.
